selection: A hierarchical COPY/PATCH wrapper is equivalent to its paid flat command and is excluded by prior analysis. The HELICAL deletion ledger has positive copy-relation evidence but no implied backend gain. Select decoder-built context-to-continuation retrieval coupled to the existing HARM edit transducer: this changes donor acquisition from explicit template-field routes to exact8-byte contexts while retaining the existing edit arithmetic. No paid copy command, HORIZON anchor or Endpoint428 trace is used.
hypothesis: A bounded decoder-built bank can select the same fully observed32-byte continuation on both sides using only the preceding8 decoded bytes, and the existing edit model can retain predictive information through a constructed insertion that defeats same-position lockstep. Corpus prevalence and parent-relative gain remain unmeasured.
retrieval: 4096 direct-mapped slots indexed by CRC32 of exact8-byte context, with full context-tag checks. Publish a context plus its32-byte continuation only after all32 continuation bytes are decoded. Newest mature occurrence replaces a colliding slot. A trigger owns one32-target-byte episode; no replacement or retrigger inside an episode. Bank updates continue on every reconstructed byte.
controls: L: unchanged same-position lockstep over the selected donor
D: unchanged causal edit transducer over that same donor
S: identical edit transducer over the donor rotated16 bytes, with identical trigger and episode length
coordinate_scope: The new adapter consumes generic explicitly identified byte coordinates. Synthetic fixtures use raw bytes. A WRT parent would need an explicitly frozen WRT adapter; no raw/WRT trace exchange or inherited HARM corpus result is authorized.
scope: Synthetic acquisition, delayed availability, collisions, state replay and insertion fixtures only. No corpus, native inference, archive, parent mixture, parameter tuning or package claim.
stop_rule: One source adapter and bounded synthetic test. Any source, availability, ordering or state mismatch rejects implementation. Passing only permits a separately frozen coding or retained-parent diagnostic, with required dependencies and costs explicit. No full-corpus score or automatic launch.
